typography.headings: Use the existing 'font-display' class for all headings (H1, H2, H3). Apply 'tracking-tight' to enhance the modern feel.
typography.body: Use a clean geometric sans-serif for body copy. Maintain high legibility for data-dense areas.
typography.numbers: For all invoice amounts, totals, and numerical metrics, apply 'font-semibold' or 'font-bold' combined with 'tabular-nums' to prevent horizontal layout jitter.
typography.hierarchy: H1: text-3xl to text-4xl. Card Metrics: text-4xl font-display font-bold. Maintain a clear 2-step hierarchy gap.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle borders (border-gray-100 or border-gray-200/60) around white cards to increase crispness against the #F9FAFB background.

login_screen.left_form: Flex col, vertically centered, max-w-md mx-auto w-full px-8. Emphasize spacing (gap-6). Logo 'openfactura by GoRoky' at the top.
login_screen.right_visual: Visible only on lg screens. Use the provided abstract 3D image as a full-cover background. Overlay a glassmorphism floating card (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-white) displaying a mock metric or 'Tax Compliant' badge to build trust and add a 'pro' visual effect.

invoices_dashboard.structure: Main content wrapped in a subtle background (#F9FAFB). Use generous padding (p-6 lg:p-10).
invoices_dashboard.header: Title 'Facturas' aligned left. Primary action 'Nueva factura' (blue) and 'Guía rectificativa' (secondary) aligned right.
invoices_dashboard.summary_cards: A 3-column Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-8). Each card: bright icon in a rounded-full bg chip, bold metric (tabular-nums), and subtle label.
invoices_dashboard.table_area: Enclose the entire search/filter bar and data table within a single massive white card (bg-white rounded-[20px] shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] p-2 sm:p-4).

components.buttons: Primary: bg-[#0052FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0040CC] shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgba(0,82,255,0.39)] transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:scale-95. Secondary: bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50.
components.inputs: Height 12 (h-12), rounded-xl, bg-gray-50 border-transparent focus:bg-white focus:border-[#0052FF] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0052FF]/20 transition-all.
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold. See 'colors.badges' for exact classes.
components.table: Cardless look inside the main wrapper card. Header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 bg-gray-50/50. Rows: hover:bg-gray-50/50 transition-colors border-b border-gray-100 last:border-0.
components.verifactu_indicators: VeriFactu status badges. Check (✓) text-emerald-600, Cross (✕) text-red-600, Hourglass (⏳) text-amber-600. Wrap in a standard shadcn Tooltip component to display the AEAT CSV.
components.action_row: Use a minimal dropdown (shadcn DropdownMenu) or an inline row of subtle icon buttons (lucide-react) for row actions (PDF, email, Stripe, pay, edit, delete).

motion.page_load: Use framer-motion (if available) or CSS animations for staggered entrance of dashboard cards and the table wrapper (fade in and slide up slightly).
motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Use specific transition utilities (transition-all duration-200 ease-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially within badges and table headers, meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1).
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: Maintain all existing data-testid attributes for testing compatibility.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings to support keyboard navigation.

login_side_panel.description: Abstract 3D blue waves. Use as the right-side cover image for the Login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: You must generate and edit .js/.jsx files ONLY, do not create or use .tsx files.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers. Always use solid colors or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur with a semi-opaque background).
Implement the 'Holded' aesthetic: lots of whitespace, rounded corners (~20px), soft drop shadows, and a clean white/gray canvas.
Ensure the invoice creation flow, badges, tooltips, and all functional state logic remains intact. This is purely a visual redesign.
For empty states and loading skeletons, design them to match the new rounded, soft-shadow card aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts for apps. Maintain left-alignment for data and forms.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally; apply specifically to interactive elements.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
